document_zh: 万感京张 感官设计代码 —— 蓝绿与雨洪、十节点设计参数、百年遗产解说序列、机构架构候选形态、参与×感官通道矩阵五项登记
document_en: Every-Sense Jingzhang sensory design code -- five registers: blue-green and stormwater, ten-node design parameters, the century heritage interpretation sequence, candidate institutional forms, and the participation-by-sensory-channel matrix

statement_zh: 本文件不引入任何新的设计主张。五项登记的每一条判据、区间与类型划分都由本包既有素材推出，推出来源逐条登记在各条目的 derived_from 字段；读者可按该字段逐条回到原文件核对。
本文件给出的一切数值均为设计目标值或参考区间，不是法定值、规范限值、造价或工程结论。凡涉及现场量测、权属、文保、市政与审批的判断，一律为待核状态。
本文件不承诺任何执行主体、任何一笔资金、任何一次活动与任何一个日期。机构架构一节只登记候选形态与适配判据，不作选择，也不代替授权主体作出选择。
本文件不产出任何指标读数：七项包容性指标与六项空间审计读数保持既有状态不变，不因本文件的登记而改变分子、分母或口径。
statement_en: This file introduces no new design claim. Every criterion, range and type division in the five registers is derived from material already in the package, and the derivation is registered item by item in each entry's derived_from field, so a reader can return to the source file and check it.

Every figure here is a design target or a reference range. None is a statutory value, a code limit, a cost or an engineering conclusion. Any judgement touching site measurement, ownership, heritage, utilities or approval remains outstanding.

This file commits to no executing body, no money, no event and no date. The institutional section registers candidate forms and their fitness criteria only; it makes no choice and does not make one on an authorising body's behalf.

This file produces no metric reading: the seven inclusion metrics and the six spatial-audit readings keep their existing state, and nothing registered here changes a numerator, a denominator or a definition.
declaration.relation_to_existing_files_zh: 本文件不重复以下文件已登记的内容，只登记它们之间此前未被写出的关系：geometry/green_space.geojson 与 geometry/public_space.geojson（要素与职能）、geometry/constraints.geojson（十节点属性）、visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json 与 visual/assets/field-verification-plan.json（六项读数的定义与执行办法）、visual/assets/service-desk-gonogo.json（七项开办条件）、visual/assets/seb-spec.json（第六组件双联交接台账）、visual/assets/seb-op04-90day-pack.json（单点位九十天口径与数字纪律）、assets/figures/op04-detail.png（八要素卡母版）、visual/assets/op04-tactile-map.json（缝合段四条带宽度设计目标值）。
declaration.relation_to_existing_files_en: This file repeats nothing already registered in the following, and records only the relations between them that had not been written down: geometry/green_space.geojson and geometry/public_space.geojson (features and roles), geometry/constraints.geojson (the ten node attributes), visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json and visual/assets/field-verification-plan.json (the six readings and how they are executed), visual/assets/service-desk-gonogo.json (the seven readiness conditions), visual/assets/seb-spec.json (the sixth component, the duplicate handover ledger), visual/assets/seb-op04-90day-pack.json (the single-node ninety-day scope and its number discipline), assets/figures/op04-detail.png (the eight-element master card) and visual/assets/op04-tactile-map.json (the design-target widths of the four bands in the stitch section).

bluegreen_stormwater.title_zh: 蓝绿网络与雨洪：三层结构关系与类型判据
bluegreen_stormwater.title_en: Blue-green network and stormwater: three-layer structure and type criteria
bluegreen_stormwater.scope_zh: 本节只给关系与类型判据。滞留容积、渗透系数、溢流标高、管径与市政接口位置一律为现场核定条件，本节不提出任何工程参数，也不提出任何河道工程处理。
bluegreen_stormwater.scope_en: This section gives relations and type criteria only. Retention volume, infiltration coefficient, overflow level, pipe size and utility connection points are all site-verification conditions; no engineering parameter and no river works are proposed here.

three_layers.carriers_zh: GREEN-001 连续通用可达与低刺激公园绿地、GREEN-002 主脊绿廊北段延伸（众智园）、GREEN-003 主脊绿廊南段延伸（大钟寺），三者均为 spine_greenway 类型并挂 ROAD-001。
three_layers.carriers_en: GREEN-001, the continuous universal-access and low-stimulation park; GREEN-002, the north extension of the spine greenway at Zhongzhiyuan; and GREEN-003, the south extension at Dazhongsi. All three are of the spine_greenway type and reference ROAD-001.
three_layers.function_zh: 承担南北连续通行面的绿化基底与非 AI 信息底线的载体，不承担景观展示职能。
three_layers.function_en: Carries the planting base of the continuous north-south passage and the non-AI information baseline; it does not carry a display function.

three_layers.carriers_zh: GREEN-004、GREEN-005、GREEN-006 三段低刺激替代线绿化缓冲（low_stimulation_buffer，挂 ROAD-005），以及十个独立完成点所落或紧邻的八处公共空间面（PUBLIC-004 与 PUBLIC-008 各承载两个完成点，故面数少于点数）。
three_layers.carriers_en: GREEN-004, GREEN-005 and GREEN-006, the three planting buffers along the low-stimulation alternative route (low_stimulation_buffer, referencing ROAD-005), together with the eight public-space features on or beside which the ten Independent Completion Points sit (PUBLIC-004 and PUBLIC-008 each carry two points, so there are fewer features than points).
three_layers.function_zh: 节点绿量的职能是降低声光暴露、提供安静停留与恢复的可能，不以绿地率或覆盖率衡量；它与主脊绿带各自独立成立。
three_layers.function_en: Node green volume exists to lower light and noise exposure and to make quiet stopping and recovery possible. It is not measured by a green ratio or a coverage rate, and it stands independently of the spine green belt.

three_layers.carriers_zh: 清河（众智园方向）与小月河（小月河场景赋能翼同名水系），只作为概念性联系登记。
three_layers.carriers_en: The Qinghe river towards Zhongzhiyuan and the Xiaoyuehe river that gives the Xiaoyuehe scenario-enablement wing its name, registered as a conceptual relation only.
three_layers.function_zh: 本层不承担任何工程职能。河道蓝线、防洪、生态与文保条件未核验前不提出工程处理，也不据此推断滨水贯通、生态廊道或蓝线结论。
three_layers.function_en: This layer carries no engineering function. With the blue line, flood control, ecological and heritage conditions unverified, no works are proposed and no waterfront continuity, ecological corridor or blue-line conclusion is inferred.
derived_from: proposal.md#蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

layer_relations.criterion_zh: 低刺激替代线的绿化缓冲不得由主脊绿带代偿：两条线的绿量各自独立成立，任一条在某一段被压缩，该段即判不成立，不以另一条的绿量抵充。判据来源是既有的「双带并列」骨架判词与断面主张中「安静替代线独立成线」一条。
layer_relations.criterion_en: The planting buffer of the low-stimulation alternative route may not be substituted by the spine green belt: each line's green volume stands on its own, and where either is squeezed on a segment that segment fails, with no offsetting from the other. The criterion comes from the existing skeleton phrase two belts in parallel and from the section statement that the quiet alternative route is its own line.
derived_from: proposal.md#蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

layer_relations.criterion_zh: 节点绿量的雨水去向以就地滞留为先、市政衔接为后；向河道的任何直接排放在河道蓝线与防洪条件核验前一律不提出。本条只规定次序，不规定容积与管径。
layer_relations.criterion_en: Stormwater from node green volume goes first to on-site retention and only then to the utility network; any direct discharge to a watercourse is not proposed until the blue line and flood-control conditions are verified. This fixes an order of preference only, not a volume or a pipe size.
derived_from: proposal.md#蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

layer_relations.criterion_zh: 主脊绿带与清河、小月河的关系只登记为概念性联系。本方案不提出滨水贯通线位、不标注蓝线、不推断生态廊道宽度；三处重点区中众智园段的清河条件已在既有深化门槛中登记为待复核项。
layer_relations.criterion_en: The relation between the spine green belt and the Qinghe and Xiaoyuehe rivers is registered as conceptual only. No waterfront continuity alignment is proposed, no blue line is drawn and no ecological corridor width is inferred; among the three key areas, the Qinghe condition at Zhongzhiyuan is already registered as an outstanding review item in the existing detailing thresholds.

node_drainage_types.nature_zh: 以下是类型判据，不是工程参数。每个节点只登记「铺装径流去向属于哪一类」，不登记容积、坡长、管径与接口位置——四者一律为现场核定条件。三类的划分依据是该节点所落或紧邻的公共空间面的既有 space_type 与它是否相邻绿带，两项都是包内既有属性。十点中九点落在所属面内，OP-08 位于 PUBLIC-008 面外约 55 m（按 EPSG:4548 复算），按紧邻登记。
node_drainage_types.nature_en: What follows are type criteria, not engineering parameters. Each node registers only which class its paving runoff belongs to; volume, run length, pipe size and connection point are all site-verification conditions. The three classes are divided by the existing space_type of the public-space feature the node sits on or next to and by whether it adjoins a green belt, both of which are attributes already in the package. Nine of the ten nodes fall inside their feature; OP-08 lies about 55 m outside PUBLIC-008 (recomputed in EPSG:4548) and is registered as adjacent.

types.name_zh: 透水铺装自渗 + 相邻生物滞留带承接
types.name_en: Permeable paving with infiltration, received by an adjoining bioretention strip
types.criterion_zh: 适用条件：该节点落在主脊连续通行面上且相邻绿带。径流先由通行面的透水铺装自渗，余量横向进入绿带内部的生物滞留带，滞留带溢流后再衔接市政。滞留带与通行面之间必须保留可探知边界（高差、材质变化与触觉提示三者并置）。
types.criterion_en: Applies where the node sits on the continuous spine passage with a green belt alongside. Runoff first infiltrates through the permeable paving of the passage, the remainder moves laterally into the bioretention strip inside the green belt, and the strip's overflow then connects to the utility network. A detectable edge must remain between strip and passage, with level change, material change and a tactile cue all present.
derived_from: proposal.md#蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

types.name_zh: 线性排水 + 市政衔接
types.criterion_zh: 适用条件：该节点落在重点区核心前厅或商业前厅一类以硬质面为主、不相邻绿带的公共空间面。径流以横坡导向设施带一侧的线性排水沟，再衔接市政；盲道与人工窗口前的等候位不得落在排水汇集处。取值沿用 OP-04 八要素卡「排水」一项的既有登记。
types.criterion_en: Applies where the node sits on a key-area forecourt or commercial forecourt, a predominantly hard-surfaced public-space feature with no green belt alongside. Runoff is carried by a cross fall to a linear channel on the equipment-strip side and then to the utility network; the tactile guide path and the waiting positions in front of the staffed window may not sit where water collects. The values follow those already registered in the drainage element of the OP-04 eight-element card.

types.name_zh: 生物滞留 + 市政衔接并置，接口缓坡面不受纳
types.name_en: Bioretention and utility connection side by side, with the interface ramp receiving nothing
types.criterion_zh: 适用条件：该节点落在地标公开记录面或横向接口一类公共空间面。此类位置同时有停留面与缓坡面，两者的处置相反：停留面按生物滞留处置，缓坡面不受纳任何上游径流——横向接口的无障碍缓坡一旦成为汇水面，雨天断点即在此处产生。本条直接沿用既有的「不向轨道遗存带与横向接口的缓坡面排放」一款。
types.criterion_en: Applies where the node sits on a landmark public-record surface or a lateral interface. Such places hold both a dwelling surface and a ramp, and the two are treated in opposite ways: the dwelling surface takes bioretention, while the ramp receives no upstream runoff at all, since an accessible interface ramp that becomes a catchment is exactly where a wet-weather break appears. This follows directly from the existing clause forbidding discharge onto the rail-remnant strip and the interface ramps.
derived_from: proposal.md#蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

assignment.note_zh: 主脊北段停靠面，相邻主脊绿带；停靠湾的横坡方向须背离候车与休息位。
assignment.note_en: The north spine stop adjoins the spine green belt; the cross fall of the bay must slope away from the waiting and rest positions.

assignment.note_zh: 原点社区易读服务前厅，硬质面为主；易读窗口前的等候位是本节点唯一不得积水的位置。
assignment.note_en: The easy-read service forecourt at the Origin Community is largely hard-surfaced; the waiting positions in front of the easy-read window are the one place at this node where water may not stand.

assignment.note_zh: 共创横街接入主脊的接口面；缓坡两端的铸刻导视与人工求助点所在位置不得落在汇水路径上。
assignment.note_en: The interface where the co-design cross street meets the spine; the cast signage and the staffed help point at both ends of the ramp may not sit on a flow path.

assignment.note_zh: 大钟寺多通道商业前厅，八要素卡母版所在节点；本节点的排水取值已逐项核定，是其余节点取用 DR-B 的来源，不是由 DR-B 推得。
assignment.note_en: The multichannel commercial forecourt at Dazhongsi, the node that carries the master eight-element card; its drainage values are already settled item by item and are the source from which other nodes take DR-B, not a consequence of it.

assignment.note_zh: 与 OP-01 同面；本节点另有具身交互急停位，急停按钮与人工接管灯的基座不得落在滞留带边界上。
assignment.note_en: Shares its feature with OP-01; it also holds an embodied-interaction emergency stop, whose button and human-handover light must not be founded on the edge of the retention strip.

assignment.note_zh: 万感原点公开记录面；可更换牌面与纸质分步流程的取用位须在檐下或有遮蔽处，避免雨天失效。
assignment.note_en: The Every Sense Origin public-record surface; the replaceable panel and the point where the paper step-by-step process is taken must sit under cover so that rain does not disable them.

assignment.note_zh: 共轨门公开记录面；触觉文化带在本节点进入地标面，触觉浮雕面的排水优先于其余面。
assignment.note_en: The Common Gauge Gate public-record surface; the tactile culture band enters the landmark surface here, and drainage of the tactile relief takes priority over the rest.

assignment.note_zh: 百感台记录面；无账户消费与退出回执位是本节点的人工兜底位置，须与汇水路径分离。
assignment.note_en: The Hundred-Sense Forum record surface; the account-free counter and the exit-receipt station are this node's human fallback and must be kept clear of flow paths.

assignment.note_zh: 与 OP-08 同面；活动疏散方向上的临时铺面在雨天不得形成新的高差断点。
assignment.note_en: Shares its feature with OP-08; temporary surfacing on the event evacuation route may not create new level breaks in rain.

assignment.note_zh: 众智园验证前厅；本节点承担 AI 关闭等价求助与疏散，纸质疏散信息的张贴位须有遮蔽。
assignment.note_en: The Zhongzhiyuan validation forecourt; this node carries AI-off equivalent help and evacuation, so the posting position for paper evacuation information must be sheltered.

wet_weather_break_correspondence.cross_reference_zh: 「雨天断点」读数的定义、单位与责任方登记于 visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json，其工具、记录字段、样本参考、有效性条件与失效条款登记于 visual/assets/field-verification-plan.json。本文件不重复测法，只登记该读数的三类成因与雨洪设施之间的对应关系。
wet_weather_break_correspondence.cross_reference_en: The definition, unit and owner of the wet-weather-break reading sit in visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json, and its tools, record fields, reference sample, validity conditions and invalidation clause sit in visual/assets/field-verification-plan.json. This file does not repeat the method; it registers only how the reading's three causes correspond to stormwater features.

pairs.points_to_zh: 指向该段滞留带的容积与溢流标高，以及通行面横坡方向——三者均为现场核定条件，读数产出后按段回填，不在本包内预设数值。
pairs.points_to_en: Points to the retention volume and overflow level of that segment's strip and to the direction of the cross fall on the passage. All three are site-verification conditions, backfilled segment by segment once readings exist, with no value preset here.
derived_from: proposal.md#蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

pairs.points_to_zh: 指向铺装材料判据——八要素卡「铺装材料」一项的既有登记为透水防滑、平整连续、反光受控；湿滑断点一经登记，即为该段材料判据未成立的现场证据，不由材料送检替代。
pairs.points_to_en: Points to the paving criterion: the paving element of the eight-element card is already registered as permeable, slip-resistant, level, continuous and glare-controlled. A registered slip break is on-site evidence that the criterion has not been met on that segment, and a laboratory material test does not substitute for it.

pairs.points_to_zh: 指向线性排水沟的位置与盖板方向，以及滞留带与通行面之间的可探知边界；本类断点同时是触觉带连续性读数的输入之一（井盖冲突项），两项读数在同一位置出现时须合并登记，不重复计数。
pairs.points_to_en: Points to the position and grating orientation of the linear channel and to the detectable edge between retention strip and passage. This class of break is also an input to the tactile-continuity reading, under its manhole-conflict item; where both readings occur at the same location they are registered jointly and not double counted.

wet_weather_break_correspondence.discipline_zh: 本对应关系不产出任何读数。六项空间审计读数当前全部为零值，本节的登记不改变其分子、分母或 unmeasurable_reason 纪律；对应关系只回答「读到一个断点之后该去看哪一件设施」，不回答「应当有几个断点」。
wet_weather_break_correspondence.discipline_en: The correspondence produces no reading. All six spatial-audit readings are currently zero, and nothing registered here changes their numerators, denominators or the unmeasurable_reason discipline. The correspondence answers only which feature to inspect once a break has been read, never how many breaks there ought to be.

four_question_method.replicable_statement_zh: 众智园段线性绿带的四问深化法（种什么、地形标高、雨水去向、夜间照明）已在正文完整给出，本文件不重复其内容。四问同法适用于其余节点段：深化随 G1 可逆原型闸门逐节点执行，不在本包内预先展开——预先为十段各写一份四问，只会得到九份没有现场输入的复制品。
four_question_method.replicable_statement_en: The four-question detailing method for the linear green belt at Zhongzhiyuan -- what to plant, ground level, where the water goes, and night lighting -- is set out in full in the main text and is not repeated here. The same method applies to the remaining node segments: detailing runs node by node behind the G1 reversible-prototype gate and is not unfolded in advance in this package, because writing four answers for each of ten segments now would only yield nine copies with no site input.
four_question_method.trigger_zh: 任一段进入四问深化，须三项同时成立：其一，该段取得限定范围、限定时段、可撤回的场地使用授权（口径同服务桌开办条件 GD-1）；其二，该段完成土壤、地下管线与现状树木调查；其三，该段的雨天断点与夜间断点两项读数各至少有一轮记录。任一项不成立，该段只保留原则，不进入做法。
four_question_method.trigger_en: A segment enters four-question detailing only when three conditions hold together: it has bounded, time-limited and revocable site-use permission of the same kind as readiness condition GD-1 for the service desk; it has completed a soil, buried-services and existing-tree survey; and it has at least one round each of the wet-weather-break and night-break readings. If any one fails, the segment keeps principles only and does not proceed to method.
four_question_method.responsible_role_zh: 园林、市政排水与照明专业，会同无障碍审计与场地运营；本方案团队在该段的现场审计与停止决定上不得担任 R 或复核人（沿用既有利益冲突纪律）。
four_question_method.responsible_role_en: Landscape, drainage and lighting professionals together with accessibility auditors and site operations. On site audits and stop decisions for a segment, this proposal's team may hold neither the R role nor the reviewer role, following the existing conflict-of-interest discipline.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「夜间照明」最先受检：本节点是主脊北段停靠位，夜间断点读数在此的取样密度最高。
per_node_difference.difference_en: Night lighting is checked first: this is the north spine stop, where the night-break reading is sampled most densely.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「种什么」最先受检：本节点在低刺激替代线上，致敏花粉与落果直接压缩安静停留的可用时段。
per_node_difference.difference_en: What to plant is checked first: the node sits on the low-stimulation route, where allergenic pollen and fallen fruit directly shorten the hours in which quiet dwelling is usable.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「地形标高」最先受检：接口缓坡与主脊通行面的平接关系决定东西缝合是否成立。
per_node_difference.difference_en: Ground level is checked first: whether the interface ramp meets the spine passage flush decides whether the east-west stitch stands at all.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四段之外的特例：本节点的连续通行前提尚未证成立，四问在 AI 关闭态连续通道核验完成之前不得开始。
per_node_difference.difference_en: An exception to the four: the node's continuity premise is not yet proven, so the four questions may not begin before the AI-off continuous route has been verified.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「雨水去向」最先受检：急停与人工接管构件的基座与滞留带边界共处一带。
per_node_difference.difference_en: Where the water goes is checked first: the footings of the emergency stop and human-handover components share a strip with the edge of the retention area.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「夜间照明」最先受检：认知友好流程的纸质步骤在低照度下失效，照度分级在此不是舒适度问题。
per_node_difference.difference_en: Night lighting is checked first: the paper step-by-step process fails at low illuminance, so lighting levels here are not a comfort question.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「种什么」最先受检：冬季落叶后的低角度阳光决定触觉浮雕与铸刻导视的辨识对比。
per_node_difference.difference_en: What to plant is checked first: low winter sun after leaf fall governs the contrast by which tactile relief and cast signage are read.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「雨水去向」最先受检：现金与纸质凭据的取用位一旦落在汇水路径上，无账户路径即在雨天消失。
per_node_difference.difference_en: Where the water goes is checked first: once the point where cash and paper receipts are handled sits on a flow path, the account-free route disappears in rain.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「地形标高」最先受检：活动临时铺面是本节点新增高差断点的唯一来源。
per_node_difference.difference_en: Ground level is checked first: temporary event surfacing is the only source of new level breaks at this node.

per_node_difference.difference_zh: 四问中「夜间照明」最先受检：AI 关闭等价疏散依赖固定导视，其可读性由照度与眩光共同决定。
per_node_difference.difference_en: Night lighting is checked first: AI-off equivalent evacuation depends on fixed signage, whose legibility is set jointly by illuminance and glare.

node_design_parameters.title_zh: 十节点设计参数：母版、参考区间与校准触发
node_design_parameters.title_en: Ten-node design parameters: the master card, reference ranges and calibration triggers
node_design_parameters.value_status_zh: 本表全部为参考值，不是法定值。OP-04 的八项为已按 GB 55019-2021 与《无障碍环境建设法》框架逐项给出的设计目标值，其余九节点未经 OP-04 级逐项核定，其区间只是类型参考。任何一项在现场审计与授权确认之前都不构成工程结论。
node_design_parameters.value_status_en: Everything in this table is a reference value, not a statutory one. The eight elements at OP-04 are design targets already set item by item within the framework of GB 55019-2021 and the Barrier-Free Environment Construction Law; the other nine nodes have had no equivalent item-by-item verification, and their ranges are type references only. Before site audit and confirmation by an authorising body, none of it constitutes an engineering conclusion.

master_card.subject_zh: OP-04 连续通行断点 · ALT-A 横向接口升级段（大钟寺片区）的节点深化八要素卡，全部为设计目标值，每项带「待现场审计」状态。
master_card.subject_en: The eight-element card for the OP-04 continuity break at the ALT-A lateral interface upgrade segment in the Dazhongsi area. Every value is a design target and every card carries a pending-site-audit status.
master_card.band_widths_zh: 缝合段四条通行带的设计目标值：多模态导路带 2.50 m、触觉引导带（行进盲道）0.30 m、设施带（导视柱、接管灯、座憩）1.20 m、安静缓冲绿带 1.50 m。
master_card.band_widths_en: The design-target widths of the four bands in the stitch section: multimodal wayfinding band 2.50 m, tactile guide band 0.30 m, equipment strip carrying signage posts, handover lights and seating 1.20 m, and quiet buffer planting 1.50 m.

elements.value_en: Kerb ramp at least 1.20 m plus a tactile warning band

横坡 1—2% + 线性排水，盲道不积水

elements.value_en: A 0.30 m directional guide path, with warning type at junctions

elements.value_zh: 安静缓冲绿带 1.50 m，设备低噪

elements.value_en: Band-by-band inspection, a monthly integrity check of the tactile guide path, and fault reports entering the SEB handover route

range_rule.statement_zh: 本表不新给任何数字。九个非母版节点的参考区间一律由母版卡的既有取值围成：下限取母版登记的规范框架下限，上限取母版登记的设计目标值。区间收紧为单值只发生在一种情形——该节点承担连续通行面（南北主脊段或东西横向接口段），此时上限即为取值，理由是连续通行面在全带上必须同宽，一段收窄即整条底线不成立。属「设计判断」与「运营设计」两类的要素不作区间化：这两类的取值不随节点类型变化，只随该节点是否具备对应构件而适用或不适用。
range_rule.statement_en: This table introduces no new figure. The reference range at each of the nine non-master nodes is bounded by values already on the master card: the lower bound is the code-framework minimum it registers, the upper bound the design target it registers. A range narrows to a single value in one case only, where the node carries a continuous passage, whether a segment of the north-south spine or of an east-west lateral interface. There the upper bound becomes the value, because a continuous passage must hold the same width along the whole belt and one narrowed segment brings the whole baseline down. Elements classed as design judgement or operational design are not turned into ranges: their values do not vary by node type but simply apply or do not apply, according to whether the node carries the component in question.
range_rule.non_apportionment_zh: 不适用即登记不适用，不向没有该构件的节点摊派一条它无从满足的要求——判据体例沿用服务等价基准中位序三判据以 service_desk_present 为适用前提的既有做法。
range_rule.non_apportionment_en: Where an element does not apply it is registered as not applying, and no node is charged with a requirement it has no way to meet. The form follows the existing practice in the service-equivalence baseline, where the three station-order criteria take service_desk_present as their precondition.

type_profiles.membership_criterion_zh: 该节点所落公共空间面的 space_type 为 spine_stop 或 spine_interface，或该节点的深化对象本身是一段横向接口升级段。
type_profiles.membership_criterion_en: The public-space feature the node sits on has space_type spine_stop or spine_interface, or the object being detailed is itself a lateral interface upgrade segment.

elements.range_zh: 2.50 m（区间上限收紧为取值）
elements.range_en: 2.50 m, the upper bound narrowed to a single value
elements.criterion_zh: 连续通行面全带同宽，任一段低于该值即该段不成立
elements.criterion_en: A continuous passage holds one width along the belt; any segment below this value fails

elements.range_zh: 平缓段 ≤2%；高差处坡道 ≤1:12 并设平台
elements.range_en: Gentle runs at or below 2 per cent; ramps at level changes no steeper than 1:12, with landings
elements.criterion_zh: 规范框架不随节点类型变化，全类型同值
elements.criterion_en: A code framework does not vary by node type; the value is the same for every type

elements.range_zh: 缘石坡道 ≥1.20 m + 触觉警示带
elements.range_en: Kerb ramp at least 1.20 m plus a tactile warning band
elements.criterion_zh: 适用于该节点与车行面相交处；无相交处则不适用
elements.criterion_en: Applies wherever the node meets a carriageway; where it does not, the element does not apply

elements.range_zh: 透水防滑，平整连续，反光受控；落在低刺激安静替代线上的段另收紧反光与色差
elements.range_en: Permeable, slip-resistant, level, continuous and glare-controlled, with reflectance and colour contrast tightened further on segments lying on the low-stimulation alternative route
elements.criterion_zh: 设计判断类，不区间化；收紧条件沿用低刺激线既有主张
elements.criterion_en: A design-judgement element, not turned into a range; the tightening follows the existing statement about the low-stimulation route

elements.range_zh: 横坡 1—2% + 线性排水，盲道不积水；去向类型见蓝绿与雨洪一节
elements.range_en: Cross fall of 1 to 2 per cent plus linear drainage with no standing water on the tactile guide path; the destination type is given in the blue-green and stormwater section
elements.criterion_zh: 设计判断类，不区间化；类型差异不在本表重复
elements.criterion_en: A design-judgement element, not turned into a range; the type difference is not repeated here

elements.range_zh: 行进盲道 0.30 m，交叉口提示型
elements.range_en: A 0.30 m directional guide path, with warning type at junctions
elements.criterion_zh: 全类型同值：触觉带连续性按每公里中断点计，宽度变化本身即为一处中断
elements.criterion_en: The same for every type: tactile continuity counts breaks per kilometre, and a change of width is itself a break

elements.range_zh: 安静缓冲绿带 1.50 m
elements.range_en: A 1.50 m quiet buffer planting strip
elements.criterion_zh: 本型全段与低刺激安静替代线并行或相邻，按母版取值
elements.criterion_en: Every segment of this type runs parallel or adjacent to the low-stimulation alternative route, so the master value applies

elements.range_zh: 分带巡检（带数按该段实际通行带数），盲道完好性月检，报修入 SEB 接管路径
elements.range_en: Band-by-band inspection with the number of bands set by the segment, a monthly integrity check of the tactile guide path, and fault reports entering the SEB handover route
elements.criterion_zh: 运营设计类，不区间化；差异只在巡检分带的带数
elements.criterion_en: An operational-design element, not turned into a range; the only difference is how many bands are inspected

type_profiles.membership_criterion_zh: 该节点所落公共空间面的 space_type 为 key_area_core，且其深化对象是重点区核心前厅本身而非接口段。
type_profiles.membership_criterion_en: The public-space feature has space_type key_area_core and the object being detailed is the key-area forecourt itself rather than an interface segment.

elements.criterion_zh: 前厅内部不承担全带连续通行，取值由现场净宽与等候位排布共同决定；下限不得因等候位而被侵占
elements.criterion_en: A forecourt interior does not carry belt-wide continuity, so the value follows the measured width and the layout of waiting positions; the lower bound may not be eaten into by those positions

elements.range_zh: 平缓段 ≤2%；高差处坡道 ≤1:12 并设平台
elements.range_en: Gentle runs at or below 2 per cent; ramps at level changes no steeper than 1:12, with landings
elements.criterion_zh: 规范框架不随节点类型变化
elements.criterion_en: A code framework does not vary by node type

elements.range_zh: 缘石坡道 ≥1.20 m + 触觉警示带；前厅不与车行面相交者不适用
elements.range_en: Kerb ramp at least 1.20 m plus a tactile warning band; not applicable where the forecourt meets no carriageway
elements.criterion_zh: 适用前提为存在人车交界；无交界不摊派
elements.criterion_en: The precondition is a pedestrian-vehicle boundary; where there is none the element is not apportioned

elements.range_zh: 透水防滑，平整连续，反光受控
elements.range_en: Permeable, slip-resistant, level, continuous and glare-controlled
elements.criterion_zh: 设计判断类，不区间化
elements.criterion_en: A design-judgement element, not turned into a range

elements.range_zh: 横坡 1—2% + 线性排水，盲道与等候位不积水
elements.range_en: Cross fall of 1 to 2 per cent plus linear drainage, with no standing water on the tactile guide path or the waiting positions
elements.criterion_zh: 设计判断类；等候位一项为前厅型特有的适用扩展，理由是人工窗口前的排队位置是本型唯一不可移动的停留点
elements.criterion_en: A design-judgement element; the waiting positions are an extension particular to this type, because the queue in front of a staffed window is the one dwelling point here that cannot be moved

elements.range_zh: 行进盲道 0.30 m，交叉口提示型；前厅内部另在服务桌四位序处设提示型
elements.range_en: A 0.30 m directional guide path with warning type at junctions, plus warning type at the four stations of the service desk where one is present
elements.criterion_zh: 位序判据以 service_desk_present 为适用前提，无服务桌者不适用
elements.criterion_en: The station criteria take service_desk_present as their precondition and do not apply where there is no desk

elements.range_zh: 与低刺激安静替代线相邻者取 1.50 m；不相邻者本项不适用，改由感官负荷超限点读数判定
elements.range_en: 1.50 m where the node adjoins the low-stimulation alternative route; where it does not, the element does not apply and the sensory-load exceedance reading decides instead
elements.criterion_zh: 二值适用判据而非区间：缓冲绿带的成立依据是相邻关系，不是宽度插值
elements.criterion_en: A two-valued applicability test rather than a range: the buffer stands or falls on adjacency, not on interpolated width

elements.range_zh: 分带巡检，盲道完好性月检，报修入 SEB 接管路径
elements.range_en: Band-by-band inspection, a monthly integrity check of the tactile guide path, and fault reports entering the SEB handover route
elements.criterion_zh: 运营设计类，不区间化
elements.criterion_en: An operational-design element, not turned into a range

type_profiles.membership_criterion_zh: 该节点所落或紧邻的公共空间面的 space_type 为 landmark，其主要界面是公开记录面而非通行面（本型四点中 OP-08 位于 PUBLIC-008 面外约 55 m，按紧邻计入）。
type_profiles.membership_criterion_en: The public-space feature the node sits on or next to has space_type landmark, and its principal surface is a public-record face rather than a passage (of the four nodes in this type, OP-08 lies about 55 m outside PUBLIC-008 and is counted as adjacent).

elements.range_zh: 1.80—2.50 m；记录面前的驻足带不计入通行净宽
elements.range_en: 1.80 to 2.50 m, with the standing zone in front of the record face excluded from the clear width
elements.criterion_zh: 本型的通行净宽最易被驻足人群侵占，因此净宽与驻足带须分别标注而不是合并计量
elements.criterion_en: Clear width at this type is most easily taken by people stopping to read, so width and standing zone are marked separately rather than measured together

elements.range_zh: 平缓段 ≤2%；高差处坡道 ≤1:12 并设平台
elements.range_en: Gentle runs at or below 2 per cent; ramps at level changes no steeper than 1:12, with landings
elements.criterion_zh: 规范框架不随节点类型变化
elements.criterion_en: A code framework does not vary by node type

elements.range_zh: 本型多数不与车行面相交，按不适用登记；相交者按 ≥1.20 m + 触觉警示带
elements.range_en: Most nodes of this type meet no carriageway and are registered as not applicable; where one does, the kerb ramp is at least 1.20 m with a tactile warning band
elements.criterion_zh: 不摊派原则
elements.criterion_en: The non-apportionment principle

elements.range_zh: 透水防滑，平整连续，反光受控；记录面本体另加不得以自发光动效作为唯一状态提示
elements.range_en: Permeable, slip-resistant, level, continuous and glare-controlled, with the record face itself additionally barred from using a self-illuminated animation as its only state cue
elements.criterion_zh: 后一条为正文既有的三条二值判据之一，在本型有具体落点
elements.criterion_en: The second clause is one of the three binary criteria already in the main text, and this is where it lands

elements.range_zh: 横坡 1—2% + 线性排水；记录面与可更换牌面的取用位须有遮蔽
elements.range_en: Cross fall of 1 to 2 per cent plus linear drainage, with the record face and the point where replaceable panels are handled kept under cover
elements.criterion_zh: 遮蔽要求由本型的既有职能推出：公开记录若在雨天不可读，公开性即在雨天中断
elements.criterion_en: The cover requirement follows from this type's existing function: a public record that cannot be read in rain is a public record interrupted by rain

elements.range_zh: 行进盲道 0.30 m；记录面入口处设提示型，铸刻与盲文条与触觉文化带同高程接续
elements.range_en: A 0.30 m directional guide path, with warning type at the entrance to the record face and cast lettering and braille strips continuing at the same level as the tactile culture band
elements.criterion_zh: 接续要求沿用触觉带连续性读数的中断口径：错位即中断
elements.criterion_en: The continuity requirement follows the tactile-continuity reading, under which misalignment counts as a break

elements.range_zh: 与低刺激安静替代线相邻者取 1.50 m；不相邻者本项不适用。活动型地标另加：活动期声环境按活动感官负荷退出点的既有停止条件处置
elements.range_en: 1.50 m where the node adjoins the low-stimulation alternative route, otherwise not applicable. For event-bearing landmarks a further clause applies: acoustic conditions during events are handled under the existing stop conditions of the event sensory-load exit point
elements.criterion_zh: 后一条只对承接活动的节点适用
elements.criterion_en: The second clause applies only to nodes that host events

elements.range_zh: 分带巡检，盲道完好性月检，牌面更换与回执张贴另立巡检项，报修入 SEB 接管路径
elements.range_en: Band-by-band inspection, a monthly integrity check of the tactile guide path, a separate inspection item for panel replacement and receipt posting, and fault reports entering the SEB handover route
elements.criterion_zh: 新增巡检项由本型既有职能推出：记录面的内容时效本身是维护对象
elements.criterion_en: The additional inspection item follows from this type's function: the currency of what the record face shows is itself an object of maintenance

calibration_trigger_template.note_zh: 体例取自 assumptions.json 中 A-CONTROLS-001 与 A-12 的五字段结构，本文件不新造字段。全部十节点共用下列模板，节点间的差异只在 trigger_delta 一栏。
calibration_trigger_template.note_en: The form is taken from the five-field structure of A-CONTROLS-001 and A-12 in assumptions.json; no new field is invented here. All ten nodes share the template below and differ only in the trigger_delta line.
calibration_trigger_template.trigger_zh: 取得该节点的场地使用授权，并完成一次覆盖八要素的现场无障碍审计
calibration_trigger_template.trigger_en: Site-use permission is obtained for the node and one site accessibility audit covering all eight elements is completed
calibration_trigger_template.responsible_role_zh: 无障碍专业人员与场地运营，会同交通、园林、市政排水与照明专业；本方案团队不得在该节点的现场审计与停止决定上担任 R 或复核人
calibration_trigger_template.responsible_role_en: Accessibility professionals and site operations, together with transport, landscape, drainage and lighting professionals; this proposal's team may hold neither the R role nor the reviewer role on that node's site audit or stop decision
calibration_trigger_template.resolution_evidence_zh: 逐要素实测记录、不可测点位及其原因、参与者复核意见，以及区间收敛为取值的逐项说明
calibration_trigger_template.resolution_evidence_en: Element-by-element measurements, the unmeasurable positions and their reasons, participant review comments, and an item-by-item account of how each range converged to a value
calibration_trigger_template.recalculation_scope_zh: 该节点八项参考区间全部作废改为实测值；同型其余节点的区间不因此自动收敛，须各自审计
calibration_trigger_template.recalculation_scope_en: All eight reference ranges at that node are voided and replaced by measured values; ranges at other nodes of the same type do not converge automatically and must each be audited

node_parameters.trigger_delta_zh: 先测的是停靠湾退出后回到通行面的净宽是否仍达取值——本节点的净宽风险来自停靠而非通行。
node_parameters.trigger_delta_en: The first measurement is whether clear width still reaches the value where the stopping bay rejoins the passage: at this node the width risk comes from stopping, not from through movement.

node_parameters.trigger_delta_zh: 先测的是声环境一项的相邻关系是否成立——本节点若与低刺激线不相邻，EL-7 登记为不适用而不是取下限。
node_parameters.trigger_delta_en: The first measurement is whether the adjacency behind the acoustic element holds: if this node does not adjoin the low-stimulation route, EL-7 is registered as not applicable rather than set to its lower bound.

node_parameters.trigger_delta_zh: 先测的是接口两端缓坡与主脊通行面的平接高差——该值决定 EL-1 的收紧取值在本节点是否可能达成。
node_parameters.trigger_delta_en: The first measurement is the level difference where the ramps at both ends of the interface meet the spine passage, since that value decides whether the narrowed EL-1 value is attainable here at all.

node_parameters.trigger_delta_zh: 本节点是母版，八项已逐项给出设计目标值，不需要由区间收敛；但其校准触发比其余节点多一道前置——AI 关闭态连续通道的存在性核验未完成之前，八要素卡的现场审计不进入 L1。
node_parameters.trigger_delta_en: This node is the master: all eight elements already carry design targets and need no convergence from a range. Its calibration trigger nonetheless carries one precondition the others do not, since the site audit of the eight-element card does not enter L1 until the existence of the AI-off continuous route has been verified.

node_parameters.trigger_delta_zh: 先测的是急停按钮与人工接管灯在坐姿与站姿两种高度下的可及范围是否落在设施带内——落到通行带即 EL-1 不成立。
node_parameters.trigger_delta_en: The first measurement is whether the emergency stop and the human-handover light stay within the equipment strip when reached from both seated and standing heights, since reaching into the passage band means EL-1 fails.

node_parameters.trigger_delta_zh: 先测的是记录面前驻足带与通行净宽的分界是否在现场可辨——两者合并即本节点的 EL-1 无法判定。
node_parameters.trigger_delta_en: The first measurement is whether the boundary between the standing zone at the record face and the clear width is discernible on site, because if the two merge, EL-1 cannot be judged here at all.

node_parameters.name_zh: 多感官遗产解释选择点

node_parameters.trigger_delta_en: The first measurement is the level continuity where the tactile culture band enters the landmark surface: misalignment counts as a break in the tactile-continuity reading, which makes this node a compulsory sample for it.

heritage_interpretation.title_zh: 百年遗产解说序列与材料经济
heritage_interpretation.title_en: The century heritage interpretation sequence and its material economy
heritage_interpretation.boundary_zh: 本节为解说组织建议，不是文物保护规划，也不构成史实结论。历史锚点只取正文已登记的公有领域通识史实，不新增任何史实主张；文保等级、保护范围与控制线一律以官方档案为准，本节不标注、不推断、不引用未经核验的站场或线路史料。
heritage_interpretation.boundary_en: This section proposes how interpretation is organised. It is neither a heritage conservation plan nor a conclusion about history. Its anchors are only the public-domain common-knowledge facts already registered in the main text, and it adds no new historical claim. Heritage grades, protection extents and control lines rest with official records; nothing is marked or inferred here, and no unverified station or line history is cited.
heritage_interpretation.sequence_rule_zh: 序列沿主脊自北向南组织，与三处重点区的既有空间次序一致：众智园（北）、AI 原点社区（中）、大钟寺（南）。三段各认领一段叙事，互不重复；解说序列的作用是把包内已有的解说载体按节点串起来，而不是新造载体。任一段可单独进入、可跳过、可重复——这是既有的触觉文化带主张，序列不改变它。
heritage_interpretation.sequence_rule_en: The sequence runs south along the spine and follows the existing spatial order of the three key areas: Zhongzhiyuan in the north, the AI Origin Community in the middle, Dazhongsi in the south. Each takes one strand of the narrative and none repeats another. The sequence exists to string together interpretation carriers the package already has, not to invent new ones. Any segment can be entered alone, skipped or repeated, which is the existing statement about the tactile culture band and the sequence does not alter it.

segments.name_zh: 众智园 · 工程起点叙事
segments.narrative_zh: 本段讲一件事：一条线路如何在坡度面前承认「上不去就要退回来」，并把退回变成前进的一部分。史实锚点为正文已登记的三条公有领域通识史实——京张铁路 1905—1909 年由詹天佑主持设计建造、是首条由中国工程师自行设计施工的干线铁路，青龙桥站以「人」字形折返线闻名。三条只用于文化叙事定位，不携带保护等级、边界或规划结论。本段与众智园的既有角色同构：通用接口实验院公开的是验证状态，工程起点叙事公开的是「当年也要先承认做不到」。
segments.narrative_en: This strand tells one thing: how a line, faced with a gradient, admitted that what cannot be climbed must be backed out of, and made the backing-out part of going forward. Its anchors are the three public-domain facts already registered in the main text -- that the Jing-Zhang railway was designed and built between 1905 and 1909 under Zhan Tianyou, that it was the first trunk line designed and constructed by Chinese engineers, and that Qinglongqiao station is known for its zigzag reversing line. They serve to place the narrative only and carry no heritage grade, boundary or planning conclusion. The strand matches Zhongzhiyuan's existing role: where the universal-interface yard publishes validation status, the engineering-origin strand publishes the fact that the work once had to begin by admitting what could not be done.

Physical models giving engineering judgement and technical knowledge a form the hand can read

segments.name_zh: AI 原点社区 · 生活变迁叙事
segments.name_en: The AI Origin Community: how living changed
segments.narrative_zh: 本段讲的是同一条线旁边的日常如何变化，材料只取既有资源四层中的「人物与口述层」与「当代使用层」：沿线居民与通勤者的记忆、公园改造后的日常使用、活动与共同设计记录。本段不讲人物功绩，也不虚构任何人的言论；肖像、姓名与声音须逐项取得同意并可撤回，记录内容经参与者复核后才公开。本段与原点社区的既有角色同构：独立生活共创院记录的是问题与未解决障碍，生活变迁叙事记录的是「谁的日常因此变了、又有谁没有变」。
segments.narrative_en: This strand is about how daily life alongside the same line has changed, drawing only on two of the four registered resource layers: the people and oral layer, and the contemporary use layer -- the memories of residents and commuters, everyday use of the park after its refurbishment, and the record of events and co-design. It recounts no personal achievement and invents no one's words; likeness, name and voice each require consent that can be withdrawn, and what is recorded is published only after participants have reviewed it. The strand matches the community's existing role: where the independent-living co-design yard records problems and unresolved obstacles, this strand records whose daily life changed and whose did not.
carriers: 万感原点公开记录墙（可更新的电子与实体双版本）
声音档案与可选播放的短叙事
易读文本与纸质分步流程
carriers_en: The Every Sense Origin public record wall, kept in updatable digital and physical versions
A sound archive and short narratives that play only when chosen
Easy-read text and paper step-by-step processes

segments.name_zh: 大钟寺 · 转运与采用叙事
segments.narrative_zh: 本段的「转运」只取其空间事实的现成含义，不引用任何未经核验的站场史实：该区的既有定位是站点四象限概念接口与多通道商业前厅，快照登记的最近接入点簇距该区 101.6 米、距该区横向接口 100.9 米。叙事对象因此是「同一批东西如何从轨道一侧到达另一侧，又如何被人采用」——从转运到采用是同一个动作的两端。本段与大钟寺的既有角色同构：包容采用市场公开的是采用回执与事故退出反馈，转运与采用叙事公开的是「东西到了之后，谁真的用得上」。
segments.narrative_en: Transfer here takes only its plain spatial sense and cites no unverified station history: the area's existing role is a four-quadrant conceptual interface at the station together with a multichannel commercial forecourt, and the snapshot registers the nearest access cluster at 101.6 metres from the area and 100.9 metres from its lateral interface. The narrative is therefore about how the same goods reach one side of the tracks from the other and how they are then taken up -- transfer and adoption being two ends of one movement. The strand matches the area's existing role: where the inclusive adoption market publishes adoption receipts and incident-exit feedback, this strand publishes who, once the goods have arrived, can actually use them.
carriers: 百感台公开记录面（采用回执、维护、事故与退出反馈）
铸刻导视与可更换牌面
万感服务桌四位序处的现场人工解说

material_reuse_criteria.scope_zh: 以下是遗存材料再利用的类型判据，对象为轨道、道砟与站台构件三类。本节不提出取用任何一件构件，也不判断任何一件构件可否取用：文保与权属核定之前，「可否取用」不是本方案能回答的问题；本节只回答「若获准，可以怎么用、不可以怎么用」。
material_reuse_criteria.scope_en: What follows are type criteria for reusing remnant material in three classes: rails, ballast and platform components. Nothing here proposes taking any component, and nothing judges whether any may be taken. Before heritage and ownership are settled, whether a component may be used is not a question this proposal can answer; this section answers only how it could and could not be used if permission were given.

criteria.rule_zh: 结构安全核定前只做展示性再利用：不承重、不作通行面、不作可登临构件。展示性的界线是可核对的——任何一件构件，若移除后通行、停留或疏散不受影响，即为展示性。
criteria.rule_en: Before structural safety is verified, reuse is display only: nothing load-bearing, nothing forming a passage surface, nothing that can be climbed on. The line is checkable: a component is display-only if removing it would leave movement, dwelling and evacuation unaffected.

criteria.rule_zh: 任何再利用不得标注保护范围、等级或控制线。本条直接沿用资源四层中线性遗产本体层的既有声明：以官方文保与测绘资料为准，现阶段无控制线，不标注保护范围与等级。再利用构件上的任何文字一律不得出现「文物」「保护范围」「控制线」一类表述。
criteria.rule_en: No reuse may mark a protection extent, a grade or a control line. This follows directly from the existing statement on the linear heritage fabric layer: official heritage and survey records govern, there is no control line at this stage, and no extent or grade is marked. No wording on a reused component may use terms such as heritage-listed, protection extent or control line.

criteria.rule_zh: 展示性再利用的三条可核对下限：其一，不减少通行净宽；其二，不产生新的高差断点；其三，不带尖锐边缘与积水凹陷。前两条沿用四问深化法的「地形标高」一行与存量可逆改造的四项条件，第三条沿用八要素卡的「铺装材料」与「排水」两项。三条任一不成立，该件不得进入公共空间。
criteria.rule_en: Display reuse has three checkable minimums: it may not reduce clear width, it may not create a new level break, and it may not present sharp edges or hollows that hold water. The first two follow the ground-level row of the four-question method and the four conditions for reversible adaptation of existing fabric; the third follows the paving and drainage elements of the eight-element card. If any one fails, the component does not enter public space.

criteria.rule_zh: 三类材料各有一条类型限制：轨道构件的槽口与钢轨侧面是白杖与轮椅前轮的既知卡陷位置，嵌入通行面附近时须做填平或改向；道砟为松散粒料，不得布置在可能被推入通行面的位置，也不得作为触觉铺装的替代；站台构件多带垂直高差，展示时须与通行面保持可探知边界，边界按高差、材质变化与触觉提示三者并置的既有做法处理。
criteria.rule_en: Each class carries one type limit. Rail components have flangeways and web faces that are known traps for a white cane and a front castor, so anywhere near a passage surface they must be filled or turned aside. Ballast is loose aggregate and may not be placed where it can be pushed onto a passage, nor used in place of tactile paving. Platform components usually carry a vertical drop, so on display they must keep a detectable edge to the passage, treated as elsewhere by level change, material change and a tactile cue together.

material_reuse_criteria.clearance_zh: 材料来源、权属与许可须逐项清权后才可使用；任何一件材料若无法确认发布者、时间、许可、用途与空间精度，只列为待核事项，不进入公开成果——本条与资源四层的溯源与清权要求同口径，不另立标准。
material_reuse_criteria.clearance_en: Source, ownership and permission must be cleared item by item before use; any piece whose origin, date, licence, permitted use and spatial precision cannot be confirmed is listed as outstanding and does not enter published output. This matches the provenance and clearance requirement of the four resource layers and sets up no separate standard.

institutional_framework.title_zh: 机构架构：候选形态、闸门持有者原则与成本量级结构
institutional_framework.title_en: Institutional framework: candidate forms, the gate-holder principle and the structure of cost magnitude
institutional_framework.declaration_zh: 本节不承诺任何执行主体，也不推荐其中任何一种形态。三种候选形态各给适配判据与前提，供授权主体比较；选择权不在本方案。截至登记日，本方案团队未与任何场地方、运营主体或授权主体发生接触，不存在任何意向、约定或承诺。
institutional_framework.declaration_en: This section commits to no executing body and recommends none of the three forms. Each candidate is given its fitness criteria and preconditions so that an authorising body can compare them; the choice does not rest with this proposal. As of the registration date the team has approached no site owner, operator or authorising body, and no intent, arrangement or commitment exists.

executive_body_candidates.fitness_zh: 适配判据：本走廊的协调对象跨铁路资产、区级事项、公园运营与沿线社区四方，需要一个具备跨主体缔约能力的主体。四方在场是本包已登记的事实，跨主体缔约能力是由该事实推出的要求，不是对某类主体的偏好。
executive_body_candidates.fitness_en: Fitness: coordination along this corridor spans rail assets, district matters, park operation and the communities alongside, which calls for a body able to contract across owners. That four parties are present is a fact the package already registers; the requirement for cross-party contracting follows from that fact and is not a preference for any kind of body.
executive_body_candidates.precondition_zh: 前提：不得同时持有 G3 独立复核席位；平台公司作为执行主体时，闸门持有者须另行指定。此外，其扩权范围不得延伸到法定审批事项。
executive_body_candidates.precondition_en: Precondition: it may not also hold a seat on the G3 independent review; where a platform company executes, the gate holder must be named separately. Its remit may not extend to statutory approval matters.
executive_body_candidates.gap_zh: 缺口：数据治理活动 AC-4 在既有 RACI 五角色中没有 R 角色对应者，平台公司形态不自动填补该缺口，仍须由授权主体另行指定第六个角色。
executive_body_candidates.gap_en: Gap: data-governance activity AC-4 has no R holder among the five roles in the existing RACI, and this form does not fill that gap by itself; a sixth role must still be named by the authorising body.

executive_body_candidates.name_en: Widening the remit of the park operator
executive_body_candidates.fitness_zh: 适配判据：主脊所依托的带状公共空间已建成开放，日常维护主体已在场，边际协调成本在三种形态中最低；本方案的近期动作（JZ-01 通用可达底线审计、JZ-05 可移动组件验证）全部落在该主体既有的日常维护半径内。
executive_body_candidates.fitness_en: Fitness: the linear public space the spine relies on is already built and open, its day-to-day maintenance body is already present, and the marginal cost of coordination is the lowest of the three. The near-term actions -- the universal-access baseline audit under JZ-01 and the movable-component validation under JZ-05 -- all fall inside that body's existing maintenance radius.
executive_body_candidates.precondition_zh: 前提：扩权范围须限定于可撤除构件与限定开放测试，不延伸到法定审批事项——该边界与点位否决权的既有适用边界同口径，不另立标准。
executive_body_candidates.precondition_en: Precondition: the widened remit must be bounded to removable components and bounded-open testing and may not extend to statutory approval matters. That boundary matches the one already set for the node veto and sets up no separate standard.
executive_body_candidates.gap_zh: 缺口：铁路资产与区级事项不在该主体权限内。凡涉及轨道竖向、跨轨穿越与控规事项的动作，本形态无法单独闭合，须另设联合机制。
executive_body_candidates.gap_en: Gap: rail assets and district matters lie outside this body's remit. Any action touching vertical works on the tracks, crossings over them or regulatory-plan matters cannot be closed by this form alone and needs a joint mechanism.

executive_body_candidates.fitness_zh: 适配判据：四方在场的事实与既有 RACI 的第六角色缺口共同指向一个能容纳新增角色的结构；联合体形态在三者中最容易把「谁对数据负责」写成一个有署名的位置，而不是一处空缺。
executive_body_candidates.fitness_en: Fitness: the presence of four parties and the sixth-role gap in the existing RACI both point to a structure that can take in an added role. Of the three, a consortium makes it easiest to turn who is accountable for data into a named position rather than a blank.
executive_body_candidates.precondition_zh: 前提：须有可署名的单一 A 角色。若 A 位仍为空缺，本形态不改变服务桌开办条件 GD-2 的 no-go 状态——联合体不是把空缺分摊给更多主体的办法。
executive_body_candidates.precondition_en: Precondition: there must be a single, nameable A role. If the A position stays blank, this form does not change the no-go on readiness condition GD-2; a consortium is not a way of spreading a blank across more parties.
executive_body_candidates.gap_zh: 缺口：协调成本最高，且停止条件的执行最易被稀释——任何一方可依既定停止条件叫停，但联合体结构下「谁来执行停止」须在成立时即写明，否则停止条件在多主体之间失去责任落点。
executive_body_candidates.gap_en: Gap: coordination costs are highest and the enforcement of stop conditions is the easiest to dilute. Any party may stop the work under the stated conditions, but under a consortium who carries out the stop must be written down at the outset, or the stop condition loses its point of accountability among the parties.

gate_holder_principle.rule_zh: 闸门持有者与执行主体分离：G3 独立复核的持有者须独立于执行主体，三种候选形态一律适用；持有者与执行主体重合的任一安排，本文件登记为不成立。
gate_holder_principle.rule_en: The gate holder is separate from the executing body: whoever holds the G3 independent review must be independent of whoever executes, and this applies to all three candidate forms. Any arrangement in which the two coincide is registered here as not standing.
gate_holder_principle.basis_zh: 本条不是新规则，是包内两条既有纪律的直接延伸：其一，正文《各闸门证据负责人》登记「每道闸门的证据所有者与复核人必须是不同的人，G3 的复核人还必须未参与制作」；其二，服务桌开办条件 GD-2 登记「维护方即本方案团队，是被审对象的作者，在现场审计与停止决定两类活动上不得担任 R 或复核人」。前者约束的是人，后者约束的是角色；把两条合读，得到的就是对主体层级的同一条要求。
gate_holder_principle.basis_en: This is not a new rule but the direct extension of two disciplines already in the package. The first, in the section on gate evidence owners, registers that the evidence owner and the reviewer at each gate must be different people and that the G3 reviewer must additionally not have taken part in making the thing reviewed. The second, in readiness condition GD-2, registers that the maintainer is this proposal's team and the author of what is examined, and so may hold neither the R role nor the reviewer role on site audits and stop decisions. The first binds persons and the second binds roles; read together they yield the same requirement at the level of bodies.
gate_holder_principle.standing_appeal_officer_zh: 两次 G3 复核之间的空档由常设独立申诉官补位，不隶属运营方与供应商——该条为既有条款，本节不重述其内容，只登记它在主体分离结构中的位置：申诉官的独立性与闸门持有者的独立性是同一条原则的两个时点。
gate_holder_principle.standing_appeal_officer_en: The gap between two G3 reviews is covered by a standing independent appeals officer belonging to neither the operator nor a supplier. That clause already exists and is not restated here; what is registered is its place in a structure of separated bodies, since the independence of the appeals officer and that of the gate holder are one principle at two moments in time.

cost_magnitude_structure.number_discipline_zh: 本节不给任何金额、比例或分摊系数。包内唯一的概念级金额区间只存在于 seb-op04-90day-pack.json，其口径明确写为单点位 OP-04 的九十天，且属该文件自设的「乙折算类」数字；把它外推为主体自持能力或补贴规模，超出该文件自设口径，本节不作此外推。
cost_magnitude_structure.number_discipline_en: No amount, ratio or apportionment coefficient is given here. The only concept-level money ranges in the package sit in seb-op04-90day-pack.json, whose scope is stated as ninety days at node OP-04 alone and whose figures are of that file's own converted class. Extrapolating them into a body's capacity to self-fund or into a scale of subsidy exceeds that scope, and no such extrapolation is made.
cost_magnitude_structure.honesty_carry_over_zh: 既有的零值登记在本节不被冲淡：截至登记日，本方案没有任何一次服务、任何一笔收入、任何一个采用主体与任何一次测试；服务桌七项开办条件具备 0 项，生态环节覆盖 0/7，两张登记表零行记录。成本量级结构是一份分类判据，不是一份收支预期。
cost_magnitude_structure.honesty_carry_over_en: The zeros already registered are not diluted here: as of the registration date there has been no service, no revenue, no adopting body and no test; none of the seven readiness conditions for the service desk is met, ecosystem-stage coverage stands at zero of seven, and both registers hold zero rows. The structure of cost magnitude is a classification criterion, not a projection of income and expenditure.

classes.name_zh: 可自持类（有服务收入接口）
classes.name_en: Potentially self-funding, where a service-revenue interface exists
classes.criterion_zh: 判据两条同时成立：其一，该节点存在一个可产生服务对价的界面；其二，该界面的等价路径——现金、人工与无账户三者——不因收费而消失。第二条不成立时，该节点不得归入本类，因为以取消等价路径换取自持，正是既有的停止条件。
classes.criterion_en: Two conditions must hold together: the node carries an interface at which a service can be paid for, and the equivalent routes at that interface -- cash, staffed service and account-free use -- do not disappear because payment exists. Where the second fails the node does not belong to this class, because trading away an equivalent route for self-funding is precisely an existing stop condition.
classes.members_zh: 万感服务桌所在的多通道商业前厅（PUBLIC-007，节点 OP-04）、百感台承载的无账户消费与维护退出点（OP-08）与活动感官负荷退出点（OP-09）。
classes.members_en: The multichannel commercial forecourt holding the Every-Sense service desk (PUBLIC-007, node OP-04), and the account-free counter with maintenance exit (OP-08) and the event sensory-load exit point (OP-09) carried by the Hundred-Sense Forum.

classes.name_zh: 需公共补贴类（纯公共底线）
classes.name_en: Requiring public subsidy, the plain public baseline
classes.criterion_zh: 判据两条同时成立：其一，该构件的服务对象是全部通行者而非可识别的付费人群；其二，该构件退出即等于底线失效。凡符合两条者，无法以使用者付费维持，其维护属公共支出而非经营支出——这是分类结论，不是补贴额度主张。
classes.criterion_en: Two conditions must hold together: the component serves everyone passing rather than an identifiable paying group, and its withdrawal amounts to the failure of the baseline. Where both hold, user payment cannot sustain it and its upkeep is public expenditure rather than trading expenditure. This is a classification, not a claim about how much subsidy is due.
classes.members_zh: 触觉引导带与触觉文化带（全带）、铸刻导视与多通道导视柱、低刺激安静替代线及其绿化缓冲（GREEN-004 至 GREEN-006）、人工求助点与安静停靠点，以及节点 OP-01、OP-02、OP-03、OP-05、OP-06、OP-07、OP-10。
classes.members_en: The tactile guide band and the tactile culture band along the whole belt, cast signage and multichannel signage posts, the low-stimulation alternative route with its planting buffers GREEN-004 to GREEN-006, staffed help points and quiet stopping points, together with nodes OP-01, OP-02, OP-03, OP-05, OP-06, OP-07 and OP-10.
derived_from: proposal.md#蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

cost_magnitude_structure.boundary_rule_zh: 两类之间设一条不可交易的边界：任何以提高自持比例为由，减少活性界面长度、减少人工可及入口或取消无账户事项的组合，即为既有停止条件，二者被打包成一次交易本身即触发停止。本条不新设规则，只把正文强度包络段的既有条款落到主体与成本层面。
cost_magnitude_structure.boundary_rule_en: One boundary between the classes is not tradable: any package that, in the name of raising the self-funding share, shortens active frontage, reduces staffed accessible entrances or removes account-free transactions is an existing stop condition, and bundling the two into a single trade is itself the trigger. This adds no rule and only carries the existing clause from the intensity-envelope passage down to the level of bodies and cost.

multi_owner_reality.nature_zh: 以下是在场主体的事实登记，不是权属结论，也不是主体名单。本包没有权属调查，四方只是「已知在场者」，不是「全部主体」。
multi_owner_reality.nature_en: What follows registers which parties are present as a matter of fact. It is not a conclusion about ownership and not a list of parties. The package holds no ownership survey, so these four are the parties known to be present, not all the parties there are.

parties.presence_zh: 主脊在继承的临时范围内沿现状街道组织，与快照登记的铁路廊道参考线中位偏差 905.879 m（读数见 visual/assets/alignment-reference.json 的 ALN-01；v8.7 以该读数更正此前「主脊沿京张铁路遗址组织」的过强表述）；轨道遗存带与在营轨道在场地南段在场；快照登记场地内跨在营轨道的穿越主证据为零，轨道竖向按无合法穿越证据只登记不画线的既定纪律处理。本方案不认定任何铁路资产的权属或管理主体。
parties.presence_en: The spine is organised along existing streets inside the inherited provisional extent and stands a median 905.879 m off the rail corridor reference line registered in the snapshot (reading ALN-01 in visual/assets/alignment-reference.json; v8.7 uses that reading to correct the earlier, overstated wording that the spine is organised along the Jing-Zhang railway remnant). Both the remnant strip and the operating tracks are present at the southern end of the site. The snapshot registers zero primary evidence of crossings over operating track inside the site, and vertical works on the tracks follow the standing discipline of registering without drawing where no lawful crossing evidence exists. This proposal identifies no owner or manager of any rail asset.

parties.presence_zh: 沿线街区控规据报道已于 2026-08-11 获批复，区级更新导则在场；批复成果全文与法定图则尚未经公开渠道取得，本方案不据报道推断任何地块控制值。
parties.presence_en: The regulatory plan for the blocks along the corridor is reported to have been approved on 11 August 2026, and the district renewal guideline is in force. The approved documents and the statutory drawings have not been obtained through public channels, and no parcel control value is inferred from the report.

parties.presence_zh: 改造提升工程二期已于 2026-08-06 建成并向公众开放，与一期衔接形成约 9 公里带状公共空间，日常运营主体在场。
parties.presence_en: The second phase of the refurbishment was completed and opened to the public on 6 August 2026, joining the first phase to form a linear public space of about nine kilometres, with a day-to-day operating body present.

parties.presence_zh: 沿线约 70 个社区、约 45 万居民；沿线居民与在地小微商户对其日常出入口直接相邻范围内的可撤除构件持有否决权，该权利先于任何主体安排成立。
parties.presence_en: About seventy communities and some four hundred and fifty thousand residents lie along the corridor. Residents and local micro and small merchants hold a veto over removable components installed immediately adjacent to their daily entrances, and that right stands ahead of any arrangement between bodies.

multi_owner_reality.coordination_mechanism_zh: 跨主体协调的最小可核对痕迹沿用双联交接台账的既有 schema（visual/assets/seb-spec.json 第六组件 handover_ledger）：交出方与接收方须为不同角色并各自署名，未决项随单移交、不得在交接时清空，接收方在接收、拒收、暂缓三项中选一，拒收与暂缓须写明理由且上一责任方继续在岗。本节不新增字段，不改动任何违例码，也不把该结构升格为跨主体协议范本——它在此只作为「协调是否留下痕迹」的判据载体。
multi_owner_reality.coordination_mechanism_en: The smallest checkable trace of coordination between bodies reuses the existing schema of the duplicate handover ledger, the sixth component in visual/assets/seb-spec.json: the handing-over and receiving roles must differ and each must sign, open items travel with the sheet and may not be cleared at handover, the receiver chooses one of accept, refuse or hold, and a refusal or a hold must state its reason while the previous accountable party stays on duty. No field is added here, no violation code is altered, and the structure is not raised into a template agreement between bodies; it serves only as the carrier of the criterion for whether coordination left a trace.
multi_owner_reality.open_gap_zh: 四方之外是否另有主体在场，本包无从判断。取得权属、租赁与建筑普查之前，本登记只说明「已知谁在场」，不说明「谁有权决定」。
multi_owner_reality.open_gap_en: Whether other parties are present beyond these four, the package cannot say. Until ownership, tenancy and building surveys exist, this register states who is known to be present and not who is entitled to decide.

participation_matrix.title_zh: 参与 × 感官通道矩阵
participation_matrix.self_reference_zh: 参与过程自身须满足多感官等价——表达只有一条通道即自我否定。本条不是修辞：它的判据是，任一参与活动若在五条通道中只有一条可用形式，该活动本轮即不成立；不成立的判定不由主办方自评，与异议同路排入最近一次 G3 独立复核的议程，由未参与制作的专业人员与参与者代表给出结论。一个只能用一种方式表达意见的参与程序，与一项只有一条通道的服务是同一个缺陷，本方案不能一边要求后者等价、一边让前者单通道。
participation_matrix.self_reference_en: The process of participation must itself meet multisensory equivalence: an expression with only one channel refutes itself. This is not a figure of speech but a criterion -- where a participation activity offers a usable form in only one of the five channels, that activity does not stand for the round; the finding is not self-assessed by the organiser but goes, like any objection, onto the agenda of the next G3 independent review, where professionals who did not build the thing and participant representatives return the conclusion. A procedure in which an opinion can be expressed in only one way is the same defect as a service with only one channel, and this proposal cannot demand equivalence of the second while allowing a single channel in the first.
participation_matrix.status_zh: 二十五格全部为设计判据，无一格已执行。截至登记日没有任何一次征集、任何一次成对测试、任何一次复核旁听、任何一条否决登记与任何一份回执发布；本矩阵不产出任何指标数值，共同设计参与结构指标保持待实测。
participation_matrix.status_en: All twenty-five cells are design criteria and not one has been carried out. As of the registration date there has been no consultation, no paired test, no observed review, no registered veto and no published receipt. The matrix produces no metric value, and the co-design participation-structure metric stays pending measurement.

activities.gate_en: G2 closed paired testing and L3 bounded opening

cells.form_zh: 易读中文、手语视频与字幕三版并出；不以机器翻译结果作为正式版本，多语言扩展在具备母语校订与相应使用者评估之前不发布。
cells.form_en: Easy-read Chinese, a sign-language video and captions issued together; machine translation is never the formal version, and further languages are not published before native review and evaluation by the users concerned.

cells.form_en: The online consultation interface is built to the accessibility walkthrough already applied to the display page -- no keyboard trap and the path reversible, non-empty alternative text, a static fallback with scripting disabled, and colour never the only encoding. That walkthrough is a self-check by the proposal team and has not been tested with a screen reader, so this cell is registered as built to the existing walkthrough. A paper route runs alongside it, conditioned on no scanning, registration or app download.
derived_from: proposal.md#更新过程本身的公共利益

cells.form_zh: 任务脚本的图示版与高对比版；同一任务在两轮之间不得更换图示版本，否则两轮不可比。
cells.form_en: An illustrated and a high-contrast version of the task script; the illustrated version may not change between the two runs of one task, or the runs cannot be compared.

cells.form_zh: 全程可朗读的任务指令；AI 关闭态复做一次，关闭态只有视觉指引而无可朗读等价物者登记为等价缺口而非失败。
cells.form_en: Task instructions that can be read aloud throughout; the task is repeated with AI off, and where the off state offers visual guidance with no spoken equivalent, that is registered as an equivalence gap rather than a failure.

cells.form_zh: 触觉引导带与触觉版任务卡；白杖实探项等待白杖使用者本人参与，不以视力正常者的模拟替代。
cells.form_en: The tactile guide band and a tactile task card; the white-cane probe waits for a white-cane user in person and is not replaced by a sighted person's simulation.

cells.form_zh: 易读版任务脚本与手语引导；同一参与者两轮的合理便利须对等，任一轮便利不足即停止该场测试。
cells.form_en: An easy-read task script and sign-language guidance; the reasonable accommodations offered to one participant must match across the two runs, and where either falls short the session stops.

cells.form_zh: 屏幕朗读软件下各做一次同一到达任务，全程不看屏幕，只测公开可访问界面；线下人工窗口路径同任务复做，两条路径的记录进入同一分母。
cells.form_en: The same arrival task performed once under each screen reader, without looking at the screen and only on publicly accessible interfaces; the staffed-counter route is walked for the same task, and both records enter the same denominator.

cells.form_zh: 议程与结论的图示摘要，在复核当日与结论同时公开，不在结论之后补发。
cells.form_en: An illustrated summary of the agenda and the conclusions, published on the day of the review together with the conclusions and never issued afterwards.
derived_from: proposal.md#更新过程本身的公共利益

cells.form_zh: 现场语音播报；不录制参与者影像与声音，旁听者的到场本身不构成同意，任何记录须另行取得同意并可撤回。
cells.form_en: Live spoken relay on site; no image or voice of a participant is recorded, attendance is not itself consent, and any record requires separate consent that can be withdrawn.

cells.form_zh: 议程与结论的触觉版目录按触觉图体例出稿，与语音播报并行；触觉版的作用是让旁听者能自行定位到某一条，而不是听完全部。
cells.form_en: A tactile contents list of the agenda and conclusions, drawn to the tactile-map convention and running alongside the spoken relay; its purpose is to let an observer find one item on their own rather than sit through all of them.

cells.form_zh: 易读版议程、手语传译与字幕；复核结论按基准四选一表述——通过、有条件通过、退回整改、关闭 AI 层保留服务——四项措辞在四种语言形式中保持一致，不作意译。
cells.form_en: An easy-read agenda, sign-language interpretation and captions; conclusions take one of the baseline's four forms -- pass, pass with conditions, return for correction, or switch off the AI layer and keep the service -- and the four are worded identically across the language forms rather than paraphrased.
derived_from: proposal.md#更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划

cells.form_zh: 线上旁听与线下到场两条路径并存，任一条单独可用；线上旁听不以注册或实名为前提，线下到场不以预约为前提。
cells.form_en: Online observation and attendance in person run in parallel and either works alone; observing online is conditioned on no registration or real-name identification, and attending in person on no appointment.

cells.form_zh: 登记表以易读中文写明「不需要说明理由」；手语与字幕版同期出，措辞与易读版逐句对应。
cells.form_en: The form states in easy-read Chinese that no reason need be given; sign-language and captioned versions are issued at the same time, worded sentence for sentence with the easy-read one.

cells.form_zh: 张贴于该点位的图示告示，属 L1 公告三种等价形式之一，告示须写明可撤除范围、试验期限、责任人与撤除方式。
cells.form_en: An illustrated notice posted at the node, one of the three equivalent forms of the L1 announcement, stating the removable extent, the trial period, who is accountable and how removal is done.

cells.form_zh: 语音受理，并朗读一次登记回执；朗读内容与纸质回执逐字相同，不作摘要。
cells.form_en: Vetoes accepted by voice, with the receipt read back once; what is read matches the paper receipt word for word and is not summarised.

cells.form_zh: 现场设触觉可辨的登记位，不以屏幕操作为唯一登记方式；登记位在 AI 关闭时仍然成立。
cells.form_en: A tactilely discernible registration position on site, so that operating a screen is never the only way to register; the position stands with AI off.

cells.form_zh: 线下当面登记与线上登记等效，先到先记，不以任一方为准；行使否决不需要证明属于任何一类画像，登记不采集障碍类别、健康状况或身份信息。

cells.form_zh: 回执的语音朗读版；朗读版包含结论、理由与异议原文，不省略未采纳的部分。
cells.form_en: A spoken version of the receipt covering the conclusion, the reasoning and the objection as submitted, with nothing omitted where an objection was not accepted.

cells.form_en: Key conclusions in cast or embossed form, readable with AI off and through a power or network failure; this is the existing discipline for cultural expression applied unchanged to the participation procedure.

cells.form_en: Easy-read and bilingual receipts, and a receipt must be takeable away; one that cannot be taken is not a receipt, because the right to consult it lapses the moment the reader leaves.

cells.form_en: The online public review record and the paper version at the node exist together and either works alone; consulting them is conditioned on no scanning, registration or app download.

coverage_check.rule_zh: 本矩阵的自检规则只有一条：五项活动 × 五条通道 = 二十五格，任一格为空即该活动不成立。空格不得以「其他通道可以代替」结案——通道之间是并列关系而不是替代关系，这与服务层「任一感官通道单独可用即可走完」是同一条判据。
coverage_check.rule_en: The matrix has one self-check: five activities by five channels make twenty-five cells, and an empty cell means that activity does not stand. An empty cell may not be closed out on the ground that another channel will do, because the channels stand alongside one another rather than in substitution -- the same criterion as the service-layer requirement that any single sensory channel suffices to get through.
coverage_check.note_zh: 二十五格填满指的是判据已写出，不是形式已具备。executed_cells 保持零，直到第一次参与活动真实发生。
coverage_check.note_en: Twenty-five filled cells means the criteria are written, not that the forms exist. executed_cells stays at zero until a first participation activity actually takes place.
